oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Lets an application call the Obsidian vault MCP server on behalf of the signed-in user. What the user may read is decided by the user's Vault.Reader app role and by the allow-list note inside the vault.
oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDisplayName: Access the Obsidian vault MCP server
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Lets this application read your allow-listed Obsidian notes through the vault MCP server as you.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDisplayName: Access the Obsidian vault MCP server as you
